query: UPDATE sync_conflicts SET series_id = $1 WHERE series_id = $2 AND (resolved_at IS NOT NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_conflicts c2 WHERE c2.user_id = sync_conflicts.user_id AND c2.series_id = $1 AND c2.provider = sync_conflicts.provider AND c2.field = sync_conflicts.field AND c2.resolved_at IS NULL)) RETURNING id
